description: This file defines a data class 'Settings' for application configuration, including environment variable loading functions for database URL and CORS origins. It includes utility functions to process environment variable inputs and a public interface to obtain the settings.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable data class holding application configuration, including database URL and allowed CORS origins.

methods.name: List[str] _split_csv(value: str)
methods.description: Utility function to split comma-separated string into list of strings, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Loads configuration from environment variables, validating presence of essential variables and applying defaults.
